a1_lesson: Change A1 (room spec v2, changes_before_any_run) found that a residual-based band carries an offset that does not come from harm: at recorded commands BCA's one-step residual delta*(s, a) averages +0.149 (seed 0), so the plan's literal |delta*| first FALLS just past the 80% knee and rewards the first points of over-throttle; measured from the row's own recorded command, [delta*(s, a_i) - delta*(s, a)]_+, the offset cancels and the penalty rises past 80%. Check (e) then required a penalty to rise past 80%. The lesson for Stage 2: (1) the paired marks compare the width at the command with the width at its 80% cap AT THE SAME STATE (direction: U(s, a) > U(s, cap(a)); any offset that does not change with the command cancels), never the width at the command against widths at other states or against a level; (2) a penalty is read relative to the recorded command at the same state, W_U(s, a) = [U(s, a) - U(s, a_i)]_+, which is what Stage 2's policy test applies at k = 1 (stage2/policy.py, k_paired), so the size mark uses the penalty difference ([U(s, a) - U(s, a_i)]_+ - [U(s, cap) - U(s, a_i)]_+) / over_pref (never larger than the raw width difference; the raw ratio is reported); (3) whether the width rises just past the knee is read at the 81% knee pair (knee_rise_T1_*), reported, as check (e) asks of a penalty.
artifacts: per world: the kept training rows of the gapped log (acceptance.load_seed(...).prepared('gap')), check 2's frozen fixed-controller gapped critic (get_critic(prereg, sd, 'gap', 'stall_aware', train=False)), check 2's saved gapped-critic actor ('gapped' / 'no_stall_gapped'), the saved cloned actor; the pinned room harness's SeedContext

join: measures.py joins one signal's scores with the labels only after both are written and hashed: both records verified against their sidecars, both files against the file and content SHA-256 their records name, both naming the same pair sets (content SHA-256), the pair sets verified too; the joined SHA-256 are recorded in every measures file
label: EXPLORATORY: Stage 1 detection rehearsal (plan section 4.4), computed outside the gate on saved gate artifacts; not a gated output; changes no pre-registered rule; no BCA band, calibrator, threshold, dose or BCA update was used (data-only stand-ins and oracles only)

labels.harmful: unsupported AND over_pref >= 0.1 AND true_pref <= -0.05; over_pref = critic_pref - true_pref; critic_pref = Q1(s, a) - Q1(s, cap); true_pref = Q^c(s, a) - Q^c(s, cap), c the stall-aware controller, exact float64, 1000 steps
labels.module: labels.py (a separate script; imports only common.py and pairs.py; refuses when signals.py, measures.py or detect.py is loaded; never opens a score file; run as its own process)
labels.not_past_80: a command not past 80% equals its cap bit for bit: preferences 0, harmless, not simulated

marks: none in Stage 1 (a rehearsal: every number is reported)

measures.doc:
EXPLORATORY detection rehearsal (plan section 4.4), NO BCA: the JOIN of one signal's scores with the labels, and
the measures. The join runs only on two hashed files: the scores record (written by signals.score_signal, which never
reads a label) and the labels record (written by labels.py, which never reads a signal). Both are verified against
their sidecars and the file and content SHA-256 their records name, and both must name the same pair sets (the same
pairs content SHA-256), which are loaded and verified too. Nothing here fits anything.

Notation per set T: for each state (pair id) the score at the command s(cmd), at its 80% cap s(cap), at the recorded
command s(rec) (T1, T2) and at the 81% knee command s(knee) (T1); labels at the command: past80 (unsupported), harmful,
over = over_pref. The paired penalty of the consumer (change A1): W(x) = [s(x) - s(rec)]_+ at the same state.

  level                    the signal's split-conformal 95% level on T4: the ceil((n + 1) 0.95)-th smallest T4 score
                           (n = 5,000), unless a level is passed (Stage 2 passes its tau). flag = score > level.
  widening_T_past80        share of past-80% command pairs of T with s(cmd) > s(cap)        (plan: paired widening)
  widening_T_harmful       the same over harmful command pairs           (Stage 2's direction mark, T1 and T3)
  widening_T_harmless_past80  the same over past-80% pairs that are not harmful (reported)
  widening_T_harmful_paired   share of harmful pairs with W(cmd) > W(cap) (T1, T2; reported)
  size_T_raw               median over harmful command pairs of (s(cmd) - s(cap)) / over       (value-unit signals)
  size_T_paired            median over harmful command pairs of (W(cmd) - W(cap)) / over (T1, T2; Stage 2's size mark)
  knee_rise_T1_past80 / _harmful   share with s(knee) > s(cap) (check (e)'s lesson: does it rise just past 80%?)
  knee_rise_T1_harmful_paired      share with W(knee) > W(cap)
  ranking_T12, ranking_T3  P(score of a random harmful pair > score of a random harmless pair), every pair (every
                           role) of T1 and T2 together / of T3; ties count one half (plan: ranking score)
  ranking_T1, ranking_T2, ranking_T3a, ranking_T3b   the same per set (reported)
  ranking_T12_among_past80, ranking_T3_among_past80  the same among past-80% pairs only: harm against mere novelty
  rate_above_level_T4      share of T4 rows flagged (about 5% at the signal's own level by construction)
  catch_rate_T_harmful     share of harmful pairs of T flagged                  (plan: catch rate, T1, T2, T3, T3a, T3b)
  catch_rate_T_past80      share of past-80% command pairs of T flagged; catch_rate_T3a_past80 is the fallback
                           diagnostic's bar (strong-current proposals along the actor's own rollouts: distance 35%,
                           exact one-step check 67%)
  false_flag_T             share of harmless pairs of T flagged (every role); false_flag_T_<role> per role
  flag_rate_past80         share of past-80% command pairs of T1 and T3 together flagged; selectivity = this in the
                           stalling world minus the same in the no-stall world (pooled phase); flag_rate_past80_T per set
  n_*                      counts
A measure over an empty group is None.
measures.level: split-conformal 95% on T4: the ceil((n + 1) 0.95)-th smallest T4 score; Stage 2 passes tau instead

no_bca: No BCA band, calibrator, threshold, dose, BCA update or BCA training arm in Stage 1. Nothing from algorithms/td3_bc_bca.py, calibration/ or learners.bca_* is imported or called by this component (the gate's learners.py imports them; they are never called). The gate's data loader (experiments/shift/dataset.py, through acceptance.load_seed) calls calibration/bank.stratified_bank to regenerate the log's calibration-bank split: a NumPy row sampler, not a BCA signal. The Stage 2 hook (detect.score_bca_width) accepts a callable and imports nothing of BCA; it is never called in Stage 1.
order:
EXPLORATORY detection rehearsal (plan section 4.4), NO BCA: the phases, one per process.

  python run_detect.py --phase pairs    --seed K --world stall|no_stall|both
  python run_detect.py --phase signals  --seed K --world ... [--signals a,b,...]   (default: every Stage 1 signal)
  python run_detect.py --phase labels   --seed K --world ...
  python run_detect.py --phase measures --seed K --world ...
  python run_detect.py --phase pooled

Order per seed and world: pairs -> signals -> labels -> measures; pooled after every seed and world.
  - every phase first checks the spec, the gate files, the room pins and the code manifest (common.begin);
  - pairs, scores, labels and measures are written once (an existing verified output is skipped, a half-written one
    refuses);
  - 'signals' refuses when the labels of that seed and world exist (every Stage 1 signal is scored blind to the
    labels) and writes signals_done.json; 'labels' refuses until signals_done.json exists, runs in a process with no
    signal code loaded (this file imports labels.py only in that phase) and never opens a score file;
  - 'measures' joins each hashed scores record with the hashed labels record (measures.py).
--out: a folder under runs/shift_explore/detect for checks (default: runs/shift_explore/detect itself).
Nothing is written outside runs/shift_explore/detect.

outputs.per_seed_world: seed<k>/<world>/{pairs.npz, pairs.json, scores/<signal>.npz|.json, signals_done.json, labels.npz, labels.json, measures/<signal>.json}

pair_sets.T1: 1500 full-throttle-region training states, default_rng([20261015, seed, 101]).choice(region rows)
pair_sets.T2: 1500 other training states, default_rng([20261015, seed, 102]).choice(non-region rows)
pair_sets.T3: 1500 strong-current states visited by the gapped critic's actor (T3a, tag [103, 0]) and 1500 by the stall-aware controller (T3b, tag [103, 1]): exact rollouts from the first 200 starts of the strong-current bank, 100 steps, states rounded to float32
pair_sets.T4: 5000 held-out recorded rows: calibration split, gap removed, bank rows left out, default_rng([20261015, seed, 81]) (the stand-ins' rule)
pair_sets.commands: command: the world's gapped critic's actor (float32 network at the stored state); cap: float32(clip(float64(command), -0.8, 0.8)); recorded: the row's own command; cloned: the world's cloned actor; knee (T1): float32(clip(float64(command), -0.81, 0.81))
pair_sets.hashed: pairs.npz (fixed zip timestamps) with a file sidecar; pairs.json records the file and content SHA-256
pair_sets.ref: recorded command at T1, T2, T4; cloned actor's command at T3 (for the re-referenced perfect band)
pair_sets.states: float64 of float32 numbers (what the environment returns and every critic and actor sees)

perfect_band_sanity.if_not_met: the script is not used to score BCA until the reason is found and recorded in a new spec version

pooled.best_standin: the best pooled stalling-world ranking among the five stand-ins (T12 and T3)
pooled.selectivity: flag_rate_past80 (and per set) in the stalling world minus the same in the no-stall world, per seed, at each world's own level

room_change_A1: runs/shift_explore/room/spec.json changes_before_any_run A1: the oracle is re-referenced to the row's recorded command, [delta*(s, a_i) - delta*(s, a)]_+; A2: check (e) requires a penalty to rise past 80%
run_order: after the room test's pooled look passes: for each seed 0-4, sh launch.sh <seed> <cpu> both pairs signals labels measures; then sh launch.sh all <cpu> both pooled

classifier_ratio.formula: log w(s, a) = logit of g: Dense 64-ReLU-Dense 64-ReLU-Dense 1 on (normalised obs / 1.001, command); target pairs (s_i, clip(pi(s_i) + a_i - c(s_i), -1, 1)) = 1 vs recorded (s_i, a_i) = 0 at the same rows; pi the world's gapped critic's actor; c the cloned actor; loss mean softplus(-logit_target) + mean softplus(logit_recorded); 2,000 torch_adam steps, lr 0.001, 512 rows per step from default_rng([20261015, seed, 82]).integers(n, (2000, 512)); init PRNGKey(default_rng([20261015, seed, 84]).integers(2^31 - 1)). Identical to stage2/weights.py and standins.py fit_classifier. Also recorded: l* = log(0.1/0.9) + logsumexp over the calibration bank of log w, with flags at l* reported beside the 95% level

density.formula: N(s, a) = 1/2 sum_k ((a_k - c_k(s)) / sigma_k)^2; c the world's cloned actor (float32 network at the normalised float32 state); sigma_k = sqrt(mean over kept training rows of (a_ik - c_k(s_i))^2)

distance.formula: d10(s, a): Euclidean distance in z-space (state 13 + command 4, standardised by the mean and SD of the world's kept training rows) to the 10th-nearest kept training row; exact (scipy cKDTree); in-sample at training states

perfect_band.formula: [delta*(s, ref) - delta*(s, a)]_+ (the room's main oracle, change A1); delta*(s, a) = r(s, a) + 0.98 min_h Q_h(s', c(s')) - min_h Q_h(s, a), (s', r) one float64 step of thruster_chain.dynamics_jax in the world's physics, c the stall-aware controller (room harness oracle64, q_head='min'); ref = the recorded command at T1, T2, T4 states and the cloned actor's command at T3 states. The sanity check; excluded from 'best stand-in'

range_hinge.formula: 100 sum_j ([a_j - hi_j]_+^2 + [lo_j - a_j]_+^2), lo_j / hi_j the 0.5% / 99.5% quantiles of the world's kept training commands (reported; not a stand-in)

residual_evidence.formula: -(1/10) sum over the 10 nearest kept training rows j of (s, a) in z-space (the distance's neighbours, in-sample) of delta_j; delta_j = r_j + 0.98 min_h Q_h(s'_j, c(s'_j)) - min_h Q_h(s_j, a_j), logged r_j and s'_j, c the stall-aware controller as the critic's target reads it (learners.FixedController), no noise

two_head.formula: |Q1(s, a) - Q2(s, a)| of the world's frozen gapped fixed-controller critic

stage2_hook.doc:
DECLARED HOOK, Stage 2 only (plan 5.2). Never called in Stage 1.

    Accepts BCA's width U(s, a) as a callable width_fn(states (m, 13) float64, commands (m, 4) float32) -> (m,)
    (Stage 2's band.WidthReader: it reads the state rounded to float32 and normalised as the learners see it), with
    attributes .name (starting 'bca_width') and .sha256 (its band file). Scores every pair of the locked pair sets of
    (seed, world) exactly as the stand-ins were scored, in critic value units, and writes the widths once, hashed,
    under out_dir (inside runs/shift_explore/stage2). The widths are joined with the labels only by measures(), after
    both are hashed: Stage 2 then calls measures(<width record>, <labels record>, level=tau) and applies STAGE2_MARKS.
    Refuses: out_dir outside Stage 2's folder, a callable without a BCA width name and SHA-256, an unknown version, a
    malformed pre-registration SHA-256. This hook imports nothing of BCA and checks no approval itself: Stage 2's
    WidthReader refuses without the user's approval of the Stage 2 pre-registration.
stage2_hook.function: detect.score_bca_width(width_fn, ctx, world, out_dir, *, stage2_prereg_sha256, version, pairs_out)

stage2_marks.a1_lesson: Change A1 (room spec v2, changes_before_any_run) found that a residual-based band carries an offset that does not come from harm: at recorded commands BCA's one-step residual delta*(s, a) averages +0.149 (seed 0), so the plan's literal |delta*| first FALLS just past the 80% knee and rewards the first points of over-throttle; measured from the row's own recorded command, [delta*(s, a_i) - delta*(s, a)]_+, the offset cancels and the penalty rises past 80%. Check (e) then required a penalty to rise past 80%. The lesson for Stage 2: (1) the paired marks compare the width at the command with the width at its 80% cap AT THE SAME STATE (direction: U(s, a) > U(s, cap(a)); any offset that does not change with the command cancels), never the width at the command against widths at other states or against a level; (2) a penalty is read relative to the recorded command at the same state, W_U(s, a) = [U(s, a) - U(s, a_i)]_+, which is what Stage 2's policy test applies at k = 1 (stage2/policy.py, k_paired), so the size mark uses the penalty difference ([U(s, a) - U(s, a_i)]_+ - [U(s, cap) - U(s, a_i)]_+) / over_pref (never larger than the raw width difference; the raw ratio is reported); (3) whether the width rises just past the knee is read at the 81% knee pair (knee_rise_T1_*), reported, as check (e) asks of a penalty.

calibration_sanity.note: T4 is drawn from the same pool as tau's rows (calibration split, gap removed, bank rows left out); the check is informative only if tau is computed on rows of that pool outside T4 (pairs.npz holds T4's log rows: set == 'T4', log_row)
calibration_sanity.rule: share of T4 rows with U above Stage 2's tau

stage2_marks.claim_rule: 'BCA flags the actor's reliance on commands the critic cannot vouch for' only if direction, size and ranking hold AND BCA's ranking score (T12 and T3, each) is no more than 0.02 below the best data-only stand-in's (the best of distance, density, classifier_ratio, two_head, residual_evidence, each scored by this script at its own 95% level; the perfect band and the range hinge are not stand-ins). 'Identifies the harm' only with selectivity of at least 0.2 in a trace test bed.

direction.rule: share of harmful past-80% pairs with U(s, command) > U(s, cap) at the same state

stage2_marks.if_direction_or_size_fails: declare the weighted version (Variant A-weighted) and repeat the detection test with this same script; no uniform-weight policy test runs
stage2_marks.pooled: mean over seeds 0-4 of the per-seed value; each mark also holds in at least 4 of 5 seeds; a missing or failed seed fails every mark (plan 5.2)

ranking.rule: P(a random harmful pair has the larger width than a random harmless pair), ties one half

stage2_marks.scored_band: BCA's band fitted with settings unchanged on each seed's frozen gapped fixed-controller critic (residual target with the stall-aware controller at the next state), and on check 3's frozen host critic; widths read only at the locked pair sets through score_bca_width; marks on the fixed-critic band in the stalling world

selectivity.note: reported in Stage 2; gated only in a trace test bed (plan 4.6)
selectivity.rule: flag_rate_past80 (at tau) in the stalling world minus the same in the no-stall world

size.reported: size_T1_raw (median of (U(s, a) - U(s, cap)) / over_pref)
size.rule: median over harmful past-80% T1 pairs of ([U(s, a) - U(s, a_i)]_+ - [U(s, cap) - U(s, a_i)]_+) / over_pref, a_i the row's recorded command at the same state (change A1's lesson: the consumer's penalty at k = 1); at least 1, so that k = 1 would cancel the false preference
